dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: This box is packed so tight, it looks like it could burst. Let's see what's inside.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Huh? What are all these plants and flowers? Oh, there's a small note here.

dialogues.speaker: Torn Bill
dialogues.text: (A torn bill. The handwriting has been smudged by water stains, making it difficult to read. Only a faint outline of the words "Foreign Trade Association" can be seen at the signature.)
